description: This file defines the SugarFieldStringmap class, which extends the SugarFieldText class. It provides methods for rendering edit and detail views, saving string map data from requests, and setting labels in the SugarCRM framework. The class handles JSON encoding of a key-value map and interacts with request parameters and template variables.

classes.name: SugarFieldStringmap
classes.description: Class extending SugarFieldText to provide specialized handling of string maps for SugarCRM.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the view for editing, calculating show keys and setting labels before calling parent method.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the view for detailed display, calculating show keys and setting labels before calling parent method.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of the string map, encoding it as JSON if present in the request.

methods.name: calculateShowKeys
methods.description: Determines whether to show keys based on vardef configuration.

methods.name: getStringMapFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts key-value pairs from the request and constructs a map.

methods.name: setLabels
methods.description: Assigns label strings for key and value entries based on vardef and global app strings.
